meta.title: India Banking Performance Index 2026
meta.marketDate: 4 November 2026 (figures transcribed from the research conversation; independently revalidation required)
meta.status: V4 research release: calculated PSB pilot plus expanded RBI-based bank-universe registry and client-side full-index scoring workbench
meta.disclaimer: The PSB three-factor pilot is calculated only within the 12-bank PSB cohort. The all-bank fundamental and investment rankings are not certified because the complete bank-wise audited input dataset and the common-date market dataset have not yet been reconciled. The data lab can calculate category-normalised scores from a completed input CSV.

fundamentalWeights.name: Banking scale
fundamentalWeights.detail: Assets, deposits and gross advances; log-scaled to limit size domination.

fundamentalWeights.name: Profitability
fundamentalWeights.detail: ROA, ROE, NIM and sustainable profit generation.

fundamentalWeights.name: Growth
fundamentalWeights.detail: Three-year and five-year CAGR, with merger adjustments.

fundamentalWeights.name: Asset quality
fundamentalWeights.detail: GNPA, NNPA, PCR, slippages and credit cost.

fundamentalWeights.detail: Earnings stability, concentration, provisioning and data completeness.

rules: Use standalone Indian banking operations for the primary comparison; disclose consolidated figures separately.
Use audited FY22–FY26 data and reconcile restatements and mergers.
Use peer-group percentile normalisation; do not compare payments banks directly with universal banks.
Use the same market-cap valuation date for every listed bank.
Do not impute missing financial metrics as zero.
Do not publish a composite rank until all required inputs pass completeness and reconciliation checks.
fullIndexRules: Fundamental scores are calculated within comparable peer categories (PSB, domestic private sector, SFB and foreign India operations); cross-category comparisons require a separate size/context interpretation.
A bank must have at least one usable metric in each of the seven dimensions and at least 14 of 25 input indicators to receive a full fundamental score in the Data Lab.
For any metric, percentile normalisation is performed only within the bank category and only when at least three peers provide that metric.
Missing values are excluded from a metric/dimension average and never treated as zero. If a dimension has no valid peer-normalised inputs, the overall score is withheld.
All numeric input rows must disclose a source URL, report page/table, standalone vs consolidated basis, India-only vs global scope and merger/restatement notes.
Five-year growth fields are derived from FY22 and FY26 audited endpoints by the scoring engine when both endpoints are positive. Merger-affected series require a documented pro-forma adjustment.

Investment scores require a certified fundamental score plus same-date price/book, price/earnings and shareholder return data; the existing market-cap snapshot is not used to generate investment scores.

psbPilotIndex.name: PSB FY26 Three-Factor Pilot Score
psbPilotIndex.status: Calculated pilot; not the full IBPI
psbPilotIndex.source: Department of Financial Services, Government of India – Banking Analytics
psbPilotIndex.method: Each metric is converted to a percentile rank within the 12-bank PSB cohort. Higher values receive higher percentiles. Ties receive average ranks. The weighted contributions are summed to 100.

weights.name: FY26 net profit (earnings scale)
weights.caveat: Absolute net profit measures earnings scale, not profitability efficiency.

weights.name: FY26 CRAR
weights.caveat: Capital adequacy is a regulatory capital-buffer measure.

weights.name: FY26 net profit growth vs FY25
weights.caveat: One-year growth only; not a 3-year or 5-year CAGR.

limitations: This score is restricted to the 12 public-sector banks and is not comparable with private-sector banks or small finance banks.
The three-factor pilot is not the seven-dimension 100-point fundamental IBPI methodology.
Profit contribution uses absolute net profit; ROA, ROE, NIM and cost-to-income are not included in this pilot.
No asset-quality, five-year growth, liquidity, operational-efficiency or resilience variables enter this pilot score.
The investment index is not calculated. Market-cap values in the existing dataset remain provisional and are excluded.
Scores are relative to the PSB peer group; changing the cohort or weights will change the results.
The pilot is based on only three indicators and is not the final seven-dimension index.
The FY26 official DFS comparison is bank-wise for net profit and CRAR; FY25 values are included for one-year profit growth.
The final fundamental model must be applied within comparable bank categories and use audited source-backed data for the seven dimensions.
